styles.sprite: High-quality pre-rendered 3D CGI game sprite for a sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector, NOT cartoon. Semi-realistic glossy hull with fine panel lines, specular highlights, ambient occlusion and soft cinematic studio lighting from the top-left, smooth anti-aliased edges, glowing emissive engines and lights. Strict top-down view seen from directly above, the front/nose/head of the craft or creature pointing to the RIGHT side of the image, centered, filling about 80% of the canvas, fully transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no frame, single object only.
styles.icon: High-quality pre-rendered 3D CGI inventory icon for a sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, NOT pixel art, NOT flat vector. Glossy metal and glowing energy, soft studio lighting, three-quarter view, single centered object filling about 75% of the canvas, bold readable silhouette that still reads at 48 pixels, fully transparent background, no text, no numbers, no frame.
styles.background: Seamless-feeling deep space background painting for a top-down sci-fi browser MMO space shooter, viewed from above, wide panoramic composition, rich but LOW CONTRAST and fairly dark so that bright gameplay sprites stand out clearly, soft nebula clouds, scattered distant stars, subtle depth, no planets or big objects in the center, no ships, no text, no UI, no grid.
